task: How to clean car interior with detailing supplies
query: How do I clean my car interior using detailing supplies?

goal.title: Wipe the driver-area surfaces of a parked vehicle
goal.description: Prepare wet paper towel, a blue cleaning cloth and spray bottle indoors, carry them to the snowy parked vehicle, and wipe its dashboard, driver door trim, steering area and center-console cupholders.
goal.final_state: The visible driver-area dashboard, door panel, steering area and cupholder console have been wiped; the person remains inside holding the cleaning supplies.
procedure: Wet paper towels at the kitchen sink and collect a blue cloth and spray bottle.
Open the house door, walk to the vehicle, open its driver door and enter.
Wipe the dashboard with wet paper towel, then fold and spray the blue cloth.
Wipe across the dashboard and driver-side door trim with the cloth.
Return to the dashboard, instrument area and steering wheel for further wiping.
Reapply spray to the cloth and wipe the center-console surfaces around the cupholders.

phases.description: Paper towel is collected and wetted at the kitchen faucet. A blue cloth and spray bottle are picked up and carried toward the front door.
The house door is opened, the person walks across the snowy porch to the parked vehicle, opens its driver door and brings the supplies inside.

Wet paper towel wipes across the dashboard, briefly interrupted by a center-control press. The blue cloth is folded and sprayed, then used across the dashboard from the driver side toward the passenger side.
The cloth rubs the driver door upper trim, pale panel, window-switch recess and interior handle surround.
The cloth returns to the central dashboard, instrument surround and steering-wheel surfaces, with refolding between passes.
The cloth is refolded and sprayed again, then rubbed around the cupholders and adjacent center-console trim.
